headline: Demolition and rebuild of the house at 81 Western Avenue approved, with more lot coverage than allowed.
summary: The current two-family house would become a one-family, and lot coverage would rise from 32.7 to 44.3 percent, above the 35 percent limit. A neighbor asked that the relief not be granted, saying the plans disagree, and the approval says the site plan controls if the plans conflict. The board also continued the 40B drainage change at 50R Maplewood Avenue to December 10. Seven other requests were approved, including a three-family conversion at 26 Addison Street and the 28 Eastern Point Road lodging house.
decisions: Approved special permit and variances to convert the Addison Street two-family to a three-family, 4-0.
Approved demolition and rebuild at 81 Western Avenue with a special permit, lot coverage and flood zone variances, and a condition that the site plan controls, 4-0.
Continued the 40B drainage modification for 50R Maplewood Avenue to December 10, 4-0.
Approved a variance to build an accessory dwelling unit with a garage closer to the street than the main house at 9 King Phillip Road, 4-0.
Approved front yard and side yard setback variances for a shed at 15 Honeysuckle Road, 4-0.
Approved a storage building at 22 Keystone Road, with a special permit for extra height and two variances for spacing and street setback, 4-0.
Approved variance allowing 7 Keystone Road to be reached by a shared driveway instead of its street frontage, 4-0.
Approved second-floor addition and a deck at 3 Highland Court, with a special permit and a lot coverage variance, 4-0.
Approved renovation of 28 Eastern Point Road with a special permit, a change to its 1970 guest house permit to 13 lodging units, and removal of the third-floor apartment permit, 4-0.
discussion: 81 Western Avenue plans: A public speaker said the plans show 51.4 percent lot coverage, not the 44.3 percent requested, and asked that the relief not be granted. The applicant's attorney said the site plan is the more accurate plan, and the board added a condition that the site plan controls if plans conflict.

50R Maplewood Avenue drainage fix: The city's technical reviewer said the pump should meet the 25-year storm standard, but larger storms could leave more ponding than the original design. Board members asked for a revised as-built plan, pump information, and updated operation manuals before a vote at the December 10 meeting.

28 Eastern Point Road plan: The applicant's attorney said the building would have 13 lodging units and no apartments, with 26 guests at full capacity, compared with 26 to 29 occupants allowed now. She said the number of occupants would stay the same or decrease.
